map.总滴数 = 液体总量(mL) × 滴系数(gtt/mL)；滴/分 = 总滴数 ÷: Total drops = total volume (mL) × drop factor (gtt/mL); drops/min = total drops ÷ total infusion minutes; mL/h = volume ÷ infusion hours = drops/min × 60 ÷ drop factor. Common drop factors: standard giving set 10, 15, 20 gtt/mL, microdrip set 60 gtt/mL. With a drop factor of 15, 1 mL ≈ 15 drops, so 125 mL/h is about 31 drops/min.
map.500 mL 液体、滴系数 15、计划 4 小时输完：总滴数 = 500 × 1: 500 mL with drop factor 15 planned over 4 hours: total drops = 500 × 15 = 7500 drops; drops/min = 7500 ÷ 240 = 31.25 ≈ 31 drops/min; mL/h = 500 ÷ 4 = 125.0 mL/h. With drop factor 20 instead: total drops = 10000 drops, drops/min = 41.7 ≈ 42, while mL/h is still 125.0. The magnitude conversion part uses "output = input × factor × source magnitude ÷ target magnitude", with magnitude steps of 1 / 0.001 / 1000; for example entering 500 with factor 15, source magnitude 1 and target magnitude 0.001 outputs 7500000.000000, i.e. the total expressed in drops (7500) scaled up by 0.001 — confirm the target magnitude is what you need before using it.
map.输液泵设定 mL/h 后还需要数滴数吗？: Once the infusion pump is set to mL/h, do you still need to count drops?
map.用输液泵时以 mL/h 为准，滴数只作为断电或重力滴注时的备用核对手段。但换用普: With a pump, mL/h is authoritative and the drop count serves only as a back-up check during power loss or gravity drip. But when switching to a standard giving set, when the pump fails, or when gravity drip is used during transport, drops per minute must be recalculated from the drop factor. Also remember that patient position, line kinking and fluid level all make the actual flow rate of gravity drip deviate from the calculated value, so review it regularly.
map.滴系数在哪里看？: Where is the drop factor printed?
map.印刷在输液器外包装与滴壶（茂菲氏滴管）上，常见标注为「20 滴 ≈ 1 mL」或: On the outer packaging of the giving set and on the drip chamber (Chamber set), commonly marked "20 drops ≈ 1 mL" or "15 gtt/mL". Microdrip sets are 60 gtt/mL, often used in paediatrics and for vasoactive drugs. Makers and batches vary, so reconfirm every time you change the device instead of carrying over an old figure from experience.
